## Baseline
Describe the expected verification behavior before the regression.

## Impact
Explain how this regression affects the verification process and any downstream effects.

## Guard Outcomes
List the specific verification outcomes that must be maintained to ensure correctness.

## Reproducible Steps
Provide clear, reproducible steps to demonstrate the regression.

## Acceptance Criteria
Define the criteria that must be met for this regression to be considered fixed.

## Optional: Metric Delta Evidence
If applicable, provide evidence of metric changes (e.g., test pass rates, verification times) that quantify the regression.
